verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's order of headline, window, then details, so it still reads as the same design. Its flaws are a tight left margin on the headline, a stained-glass window that looks cropped and jammed against the top and bottom edges, and a three-line details block set very small and right-aligned. B moves the window to the far left, which breaks the original reading order. Its details column is the worse flaw: it breaks "November 13, 11 / a.m." and leaves "a.m." orphaned, and the type is tiny and the lines are ragged. The headline sits in the middle with uneven spacing.
